name: Suspicious Hoofprints
summary: At the Shady Rest Inn, hoofprints lead into the marsh. Its bare frame still smokes, and the tracks fade across the soft ground. Krog at Brackenwall Village should hear of them.

sections.title: Prints in the Mud
sections.body: The Shady Rest Inn is a smoking frame, with hoofprints stretching away into the marsh. Some impressions show clearly, while others are nearly lost in the soft ground. You carry word of the tracks to Krog at Brackenwall Village.

sections.title: Krog's Reply
sections.body: Krog suspects the quilboar or the centaur may have burned the inn. Both have a sizeable presence in the Barrens, and either could have done it. The inn's owner also lost a woman and a pup, both killed. So Krog sends Kagoro to learn where the tracks lead.

faq.answer: The hoofprints lead away from the Shady Rest Inn, whose bare frame still smokes, and cross the marsh's soft ground.

faq.q: Who should hear about the hoofprints?
faq.answer: You should report the hoofprints to Krog at Brackenwall Village.
A few hoofprints show clearly, while more rows are nearly lost in the mud.
